{{Top|leg}}
The '''fixed-signature tracker''' was a tracking device that was developed for the [[New Jedi Order]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] by [[Talon Karrde]]. During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] it was incorporated into the hulls of Republic ships and transports, including the ''[[Errant Venture/Legends|Errant Venture]]'' and the ''[[Jade Sabre]]'', so that the Galactic citizens could communicated without fear of their transmissions being detected by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]].

Using a fixed-signature that passed through relays and the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]], no one without a encryption key could decipher the messages.
